headwords.text: To dream of a quay, denotes that you will contemplate making a long tour in the near future. To see vessels while standing on the quay, denotes the fruition of wishes and designs.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `docks`(부두)에 둘째 문장만 더한다 — 「부두」가 이미 그 별칭이다. 첫 문장(그냥 부두 꿈)은 기존 「부두에 있음」(밀러 Docks, 흉 — 언짢은 여정)과 같은 그림인데 정반대에 가까운 극성(밀러 Quay는 중립적인 「먼 여행을 헤아림」)이라 판별어로 못 가른다

headwords.text: To dream of a queen, foretells succesful{sic} ventures. If she looks old or haggard, there will be disappointments connected with your pleasures.
headwords.note: 기존 상징 `queen`(여왕)에 더한다 — "empress"가 이미 그 영어 별칭이다. 원문의 「succesful{sic}」는 원서 자체의 오탈자 표시라 그대로 인용한다. 각주 [181]은 「Empress 항목 참고」다

headwords.text: To question the merits of a thing in your dreams, denotes that you will suspect some one whom you love of unfaithfulness, and you will fear for your speculations. To ask a question, foretells that you will earnestly strive for truth and be successful. If you are questioned, you will be unfairly dealt with.

To find yourself in quicksand while dreaming, you will meet with loss and deceit. If you are unable to overcome it, you will be involved in overwhelming misfortunes. For a young woman to be rescued by her lover from quicksand, she will possess a worthy and faithful husband, who will still remain her lover.

To dream of quills, denotes to the literary inclined a season of success. To dream of them as ornaments, signifies a rushing trade, and some remuneration. For a young woman to be putting a quill on her hat, denotes that she will attempt many conquests, and her success will depend upon her charms.
